basic_info.description: Spacious Condo That Lives Like a House in Coveted Corona Heights    Discover the perfect blend of privacy, space, and convenience in this charming, tenant-occupied condo nestled in a duplex-style HOA in sought-after Corona Heights. Offering the feel of a single-family home, this residence boasts 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, a private garage, and exclusive outdoor space.    Step inside to a bright and inviting living room that flows seamlessly into a designated dining area, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The well-appointed kitchen offers modern conveniences, while the half bathroom on the main level adds extra functionality.    Downstairs, you'll find two comfortable bedrooms and a full bathroom, providing a peaceful retreat from city life. Enjoy the added luxury of a private outdoor space, perfect for relaxing or dining al fresco.    Additional highlights include a one-car garage, a dedicated laundry/storage room, and an unbeatable location near Castro, Duboce Park, and public transit.    Whether you're an investor or a future owner-occupant, this is a rare opportunity to own a spacious, house-like condo in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
